about: THE BUILD TARGETS (kb/Work PB5207, PB5218; scripts/buildgraph.py): each test assembly is a target with DECLARED INPUTS, and its key is a digest of the git blob ids of the tracked paths those inputs match, minus the excluded classes, plus its facets. A pass is recorded once per target and key in the one store every worktree shares. An input missed here is a FALSE GREEN, so every entry names its reader, and `python scripts/buildgraph.py check` (the BUILD TARGETS audit) fails when a test source of an assembly names a repository path outside its target's inputs.

build.about: What building a test assembly and the compiler it tests reads, shared by every test target ('@build').

inputs.src/: every product project (the compiler, the runtime, the CLI the suites drive)
inputs.Directory.Build.props: the root props every project imports
inputs..gitattributes: the checkout's bytes of every file a test reads
inputs.toolchain.env: the tool versions (also the toolchain facet)
inputs.tests/Directory.Build.props: the test-tree props: links tests/_shared/*.cs and the weights into every test project
inputs.tests/_shared/: linked into every test project (TestRepo, SuiteManifest, the gate framework, the weights)

inputs.@population-inputs: the compiler's unit tests and the repository's drift tests in one assembly read nearly every path a test may read, the names of every tracked file among them (tests/_shared/TrackedTree.cs); until stage 2 splits repo-drift out of it, its inputs are every population input (inert_lane.Classification.is_population_input)

inputs.@build: the compiler, the runtime and the CLI it builds and runs
inputs.tests/WiseOwl.Cobol.Tests.Conformance/: its own sources, project and data
inputs.conformance-suite/: the suite's tests, adapters and harness (SuiteManifest runs harness/generate.py --out; ConformanceSuite runs harness/run.py)
inputs.tests/nist/: the NIST corpus, its manifest, data and goldens (CorpusManifest, NistRunner)
inputs.tests/version-matrix/: the construct catalogue (VersionBehaviorMatrixTests) and, through harness/generate.py, the traceability inventory of both editions, inventory-schema.json, reserved-words.json, annex-a2-undefined.json and conformance-register.json (traced run of generate.py --out, kb/Work PB5218)
inputs.scripts/spec/: harness/generate.py imports construct_store, inventory_schema, inventory_view, inventory_store, lineage, generated_output
inputs.tests/doc-facts/: DocFacts (tests/_shared), used by DynamicLengthTests and StopGobackExitCodeTests (found by the BUILD TARGETS audit)

judged.tests/WiseOwl.Cobol.Tests.Conformance/Co: TestRepo.Scripts(script) over the literal arrays of guard scripts it names (guard-fast.sh, guard-run-group.sh, guard-nist-audit.sh): each matches scripts/guard*.sh

inputs.@build: the compiler and runtime it drives
inputs.tests/WiseOwl.Cobol.Tests.Characterizati: its own sources, project and snapshots (CharacterizationCorpus SnapshotDir)
